methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing was collected by WebFetch of each vendor's official pricing page (accessed 2026-06-15). Where official pages returned HTTP 403, JS-only blank content, or EUR-geolocated prices, the fallback was a reputable 2026 comparison/review article (photutorial.com, epidemicsound.com blog comparisons, cchound.com, hellothematic.com, freelancevideocollective.com) published or updated in 2025–2026. TunePocket pricing was obtained directly from tunepocket.com/pricing/. monthlyUsd is always the effective per-month amount when billed annually (lowest committed tier). Month-to-month prices and annual lump-sum totals are noted in the notes field. annualDiscountPct is set only when both monthly and annual prices are corroborated. minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overagePerMin/overagePerCall are null throughout — this is a non-telephony vertical. hipaa/baa/bilingual are null as none of these services publish HIPAA, BAA, or bilingual commitments on their pricing pages. Quote-only/enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd=null.

vendors.name: Epidemic Sound
vendors.provenance: Official epidemicsound.com/pricing/ returned content but prices were not rendered (JS-only). USD prices from lesfm.net (published 2026-03-20) corroborated by epidemicsound.com/blog/musicbed-vs-epidemic-sound/ (updated 2026-04-28) and cchound.com/epidemic-sound discount page (updated 2026-06-12).

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: Annual plan: $9.99/mo ($119.88/yr billed upfront). Month-to-month: $17.99/mo. Unlimited downloads; personal/social/YouTube use; copyright protection; no client work or ad campaigns.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Annual plan: $16.99/mo ($203.88/yr billed upfront). Month-to-month: $39.99/mo. Unlimited downloads; covers client work and commercial projects; no minimum term. Covers YouTube, podcasts, social media, films, TV shows.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Annual plan: $29.99/mo (~$360/yr). Month-to-month: $74.99/mo. Covers ad campaigns, digital ads, all commercial use. Minimum 12-month term for Enterprise agreements.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales. Minimum 12-month commitment. Tailored for large businesses and agencies.

vendors.name: Artlist
vendors.provenance: Official artlist.io/pricing returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch. USD prices from photutorial.com/artlist-pricing/ (last updated 2026-05-18) corroborated by cchound.com/artlist/artlist-subscription-plans-and-pricing/ (last updated 2026-05-14). All standard plans are annual-only; monthly billing available on Music & SFX Social and AI plans at ~40-50% premium.

plans.name: Music & SFX Social
plans.notes: Annual billing: $9.99/mo. Month-to-month option: $14.99/mo. Covers music + sound effects; limited to 1 channel per social platform. Includes Adobe Premiere Pro extension. No client work or commercial ads coverage.

plans.name: Music & SFX Pro
plans.notes: Annual billing only: $24.92/mo ($299.04/yr). Includes music + stems + sound effects; commercial license covering multiple channels and client work. Music-only Pro tier is $16.58/mo ($199/yr).

plans.name: Artlist Max
plans.notes: Annual billing only: $39.99/mo ($479.88/yr). All-in-one bundle: music, stems, SFX, 8K footage, video templates, LUTs, AI tools (Artlist Studio), plugins. Full commercial license including ads and client work.

plans.name: Max Teams
plans.notes: Annual billing: $33.99/member/mo for teams of 2–7 members. Full Max bundle per seat. Larger teams (50+ employees) or Enterprise require custom quote.

vendors.name: Soundstripe
vendors.provenance: Official soundstripe.com/pricing and app.soundstripe.com/pricing redirected to pages returning empty/JS-only content. USD prices from freelancevideocollective.com/reviews/soundstripe/ (updated 2026-05-22) corroborated by photutorial.com/soundstripe-pricing/ (article dated 2025-06-11). Business plan is custom/quote-only per soundstripe.com FAQ.

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: Annual billing: $9.99/mo ($119/yr). Month-to-month: $19.99/mo. 10,000+ songs, ~100,000 sound effects, Adobe Express extension. Personal projects only; 1 YouTube channel auto-clearance.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Annual billing: $19.99/mo ($239/yr). Month-to-month: $39.99/mo. Everything in Personal plus stems, alternate versions, AI customization tools, Adobe Premiere Pro and Frame.io plugins. Commercial license; client work and ads; 5 YouTube channels.

plans.name: Pro Plus
plans.notes: Annual billing: $33.99/mo ($399/yr). Month-to-month: $69.99/mo. Everything in Pro plus 100,000+ video clips. Commercial license same as Pro.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales. 3+ seats. Enhanced licensing for TV, film, radio, branded content. Dedicated support, unlimited projects. Previously listed at $999/yr for small nonprofits (single seat).

vendors.name: Musicbed
vendors.provenance: Official musicbed.com/plans and /pricing returned JS-only blank content. USD price ranges sourced from epidemicsound.com/blog/musicbed-vs-epidemic-sound/ (updated 2026-04-28) corroborated by omr.com/en/reviews/product/musicbed/pricing (last updated 2024-01). Exact per-tier breakdown not published by Musicbed; pricing varies by use case (filmmaker, wedding, podcaster, production company). monthlyUsd reflects the lowest-published starting point for each tier.

plans.name: Individual
plans.notes: Starting at $29.99/mo (12 monthly installments) or $329.89/yr billed annually. Range extends to $109.98/mo ($1,208.88/yr) depending on use case (filmmaker, wedding, podcaster). Covers freelance filmmakers, wedding videographers, YouTubers. 14-day free trial. Client-work-inclusive tier starts at $99.99/mo.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Starting at $99.99/mo (12 monthly installments) or $1,099.89/yr billed annually. Range extends to $219.98/mo ($2,428.88/yr). For production companies, agencies, brands, non-profits with up to 250 employees.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales. Tailored for large enterprises and major productions.

vendors.name: Uppbeat
vendors.provenance: Official uppbeat.io/pricing returned EUR prices (geo-located EU). USD monthly prices sourced from hellothematic.com/thematic-vs-uppbeat/ (published 2026-04-09) corroborated by uppbeat.io/blog comparison article (2026). Annual billing applies a 20-40% discount per plan; exact annual USD amounts not published on pricing page — annualDiscountPct set only for plans where discount range is stated. monthlyUsd reflects the month-to-month USD price as annual USD equivalent is not confirmed by a primary source.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Limited to a fixed number of free downloads per month (sources report 3–10 tracks/month). Personal and YouTube use only with attribution. No sound effects or commercial license.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Month-to-month: $7.99/mo. Annual billing saves ~20% (exact annual USD price not confirmed; approximately $76.70/yr). Unlimited music and sound effects downloads; safelist one YouTube channel; individual license.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: Month-to-month: $11.99/mo. Annual billing saves ~20% (exact annual USD not confirmed; approximately $115.10/yr). Unlimited music, sound effects, motion graphics, and LUTs; safelist 3 YouTube channels; individual and small team license.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Month-to-month: $27.99/mo. Annual billing saves ~40% (exact annual USD not confirmed; approximately $201.50/yr). Unlimited music, sound effects, 4K video, motion graphics, LUTs, WAV files; safelist 10 YouTube channels; priority support; extended license covering organizations of any scale, digital ads, and client content.

vendors.name: PremiumBeat
vendors.provenance: Official premiumbeat.com/pricing returned HTTP 403. Official blog post premiumbeat.com/blog/which-premiumbeat-subscription-plan-is-right-for-you/ (updated 2024-08-27) confirmed Creator $14.99/mo and Standard $59.99/mo for month-to-month; annual prices $9.99/mo and $24.99/mo. Corroborated by photutorial.com/premiumbeat-review/ (updated 2026-06-16) and epidemicsound.com/blog/premiumbeat-vs-epidemic-sound/ (updated 2025-12-19). A Shutterstock brand; per-track licensing ($39–$999) also available without subscription.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: Annual billing: $9.99/mo ($119.88/yr billed upfront). Month-to-month: $14.99/mo. Unlimited royalty-free music downloads for personal and single social channel use. Music only — no sound effects. No client work or commercial ad coverage.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Annual billing: $24.99/mo ($299.88/yr billed upfront). Month-to-month: $59.99/mo. Unlimited downloads; client work rights; monetization across 5 social channels; covers web, social, podcast. Does not cover TV, film, apps, or games — those require Enterprise.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales. Covers TV, film, apps, and games. Includes unlimited downloads and customized licensing for large businesses and agencies.

vendors.name: TunePocket
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from tunepocket.com/pricing/ (accessed 2026-06-15), which rendered full pricing content. Site notes 'We haven't increased our prices since 2018!' All plans are annual-only subscriptions or one-time payments.

plans.name: Personal Membership
plans.notes: Annual-only: $99/yr ($8.25/mo equivalent). Unlimited downloads. For individual creators, YouTubers, videographers, marketers, entrepreneurs. Lifetime royalty-free license per download. No month-to-month option.

plans.name: Business Membership
plans.notes: Annual-only: $199/yr ($16.58/mo equivalent). Unlimited downloads. For incorporated businesses, organizations, agencies. Includes commercial use for client projects and advertising. No month-to-month option.

plans.name: Pay As You Go
plans.notes: One-time payment of $39 for any 5 audio files (songs, loops, or sound effects). No recurring fees. Lifetime license per download. Not a subscription — monthlyUsd=null as it is not a recurring plan.
